models_evaluated: ARTEMIS-POC algorithm (machine learning, single point-of-care hs-cTnI)

links.outcome: Rule-out efficacy and safety across clinical subgroups and across two geographic cohorts
links.effect: Superior rule-out efficacy persisted across all clinically relevant subgroups (age, sex, symptom onset, eGFR, comorbidities); additional analyses were run for each cohort separately. Overall NPV 99.96%, sensitivity 99.68%.
links.quote: Superior efficacy persisted across all clinically relevant subgroups.

screen.reason: Retrospective external validation study comparing the diagnostic performance and safety of an ML-based decision support tool (ARTEMIS) using POC troponin against standard guideline pathways in emergency cohorts.
